title.purpose: Compact form and content section headings.

body.purpose: Operational UI; prose increases line-height to 1.65.

code.purpose: Code blocks; inline code and addresses use the same family.

shadows.name: workspace
shadows.purpose: Ordinary cards and controls stay flat.

shadows.name: authentication
shadows.purpose: Sign-in panel above the radial particle field; setup panels retain the centered treatment.

motion.name: rail-open
motion.purpose: Desktop hover or focus within reveals the 214px panel over a reserved 68px rail. The panel and inner navigation counter-translate from -146px and 146px to zero while labels unclip; icons and page content stay stationary.

motion.name: rail-close
motion.purpose: Closes only when both hover and keyboard focus leave. Matches Hookwise, including its user-triggered rail transition exception under reduced motion in Windows/RDP; decorative logo motion remains reduced.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Button fill, text and border changes.

motion.name: row-highlight
motion.purpose: New-row highlight fades from its tinted state.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: CSS animations and transitions shorten and animations use one iteration; scrolling is immediate. User-triggered desktop rail transitions retain their own timing. The sign-in particle loop starts paused and animated wordmarks use runtime canvas posters. The visible animation control can resume sign-in motion.

motion.name: login-particle-loop
motion.purpose: Quiet radial particle current, paused while the document is hidden or animation is paused; the form remains visible.

focus.purpose: Shared keyboard focus for interactive elements; inset fields use their dedicated ring. Desktop rail links use an inset 0 0 0 2px focus-color shadow so focus remains visible inside the label clip.

extensions.tonalRampNote: Ramps are synthesized OKLCH preview strips, not additional normative application colors.

narrative.overview:
Blocklist uses charcoal surfaces, restrained color, and familiar controls to make network access records easy to scan and act on. The visual voice is contemporary, neutral, and exact. Shared navigation, quiet borders, and compact typography give dense operational screens a consistent rhythm.

The original animated APNG wordmark anchors the shared shell and sign-in screen. Sign-in pairs the wordmark with a stable translucent form and a quiet radial particle field; decorative motion can be paused and responds to reduced-motion preferences. The system records the presentation implemented in `cmd/server/static/css/app.css` and the API documentation field stylesheet; workflow and content decisions remain in PRODUCT.md and the application surface brief.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral surfaces with clear text and subtle dividing rules.
Color distinguishes routine actions, enforcement, destructive intent, and state.
Compact data layouts adapt to narrow screens without hiding permitted routes.
Motion supports feedback; decorative sign-in motion is pausable and reduced-motion aware.

rules.name: The Semantic Action Rule
rules.body: Routine primary actions use off-white; enforcement and sign-in use solid red; destructive actions use muted red; green communicates live or successful state.

rules.name: The Local Overflow Rule
rules.body: Wide tables and code scroll inside their own region; they must not widen the page.

rules.name: The Stationary Workspace Rule
rules.body: Desktop navigation reveals its labels over the page while icons and the main content stay in place; hover and keyboard focus share the same open state.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary workspace surfaces flat; reserve shadow and blur for transient feedback and the authentication panel.

rules.name: The Presentation Boundary Rule
rules.body: Visual changes preserve application requests, state, permissions, element IDs, event attributes, and script-owned behavior.

dos: Do reuse the shared shell, tokens, and control geometry.
Do keep action and status colors tied to their documented meaning.
Do keep forms readable and permitted navigation visible at narrow widths.
Do preserve keyboard focus and local scrolling for wide records and code.
Do keep desktop icons and content stationary as navigation opens on hover or keyboard focus.
Do retain the original animated wordmark and the sign-in particle character, with pause and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn routine actions red because a legacy class name contains danger.
Don't add decorative elevation or blur to ordinary workspace panels.
Don't use the logo lettering as a general interface font.
Don't change workflows, requests, permissions, or script behavior during presentation work.
